name: Chikan Circle 2 ~Waisetsu Express Hatsudou Hen~
original_name: 痴漢サークル2～猥褻エクスプレス・発動篇～
source:
Junichi is a university student. He joined the "Chikan (molestation) Circle" a while ago and now enjoys Chikan life with Yui. One day, he meets two girls on the train. One is Hazuki, who is always severe with her co-workers, and the other is Miho, an idol girl. He soon decides to recruit them into the Chikan Circle....
